newsitem.title: USA: International Nursing to sell N.Y. opers.
newsitem.headline: International Nursing to sell N.Y. opers.

text.p: DENVER, Colo., July 11 ( Reuter) - International Nursing Services Inc said Friday it had signed a non-binding letter of intent to sell the assets of its New York based operations.
The company did not provide the name of the buyer but said that on closing it would receive payment totaling $3.5 million in cash and notes and $800,000 in common stock.

The proceeds of the sale will allow the company to liquidate certain short-term debt, provide working capital, and enable it to concentrate on its operations in Colorado, Texas and California, it said.
International Nursing operates three health care staffing and licensed home care agencies in the Bronx and Yonkers, N.Y.
